name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Fixes a systemic bug found live while testing 0.0.39: RemoteServerClient's JsonSerializerOptions had no string-enum converter, so System.Text.Json fell back to expecting enum fields as raw numbers instead of names. Every modern Jellyfin server (every remote this plugin talks to) serializes enums as their string name - e.g. "Protocol":"File" - so deserializing any PlaybackInfo response threw on its very first enum field, every single time, for every item, on every server. Confirmed live: querying a remote directly showed an entirely ordinary response, yet the plugin's own deserialization of that exact payload threw JsonException on every attempt. This was not occasional - GetPlaybackInfoAsync has been silently failing on every call and falling back to null, meaning federated items never got the remote's fast, accurate codec/container info and always fell back to local ffprobe discovery instead, and the 15s PlaybackInfo cache added in 0.0.37 never had a successful response to cache. Added JsonStringEnumConverter to the shared JsonOpts. No config or data migration.
